It compares builds to output a change diff and offers a free scan for failed requests, console errors, and empty shell routes.Why it’s interestingIt tests web apps built by AI tools using visual LLM agents and provides a free, no-signup browser-recorded diagnostic scan.Target userDevelopers of web applications built with Lovable, Bolt, v0, or Cursor that shipped with zero tests.Business modelA 500 dollar founding pilot paid tier offering baseline runs and rerun diffs.Source metrics: Points 1 · Comments 0HN discussion · ProjectSource: #HackerNews / Show HN
item.description:
🛠️ JinuGen – Simulated users test your deployed web app in a real browser

Summary
JinuGen uses simulated LLM agent users in a real browser via Playwright to test deployed web applications. It compares builds to output a change diff and offers a free scan for failed requests, console errors, and empty shell routes.

Why it’s interesting
It tests web apps built by AI tools using visual LLM agents and provides a free, no-signup browser-recorded diagnostic scan.

Target user
Developers of web applications built with Lovable, Bolt, v0, or Cursor that shipped with zero tests.

Business model
A 500 dollar founding pilot paid tier offering baseline runs and rerun diffs.
